headings.usage: All page titles, section headers, and modal titles. Use tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: General text, data tables, form inputs. Use normal tracking.

mono.usage: Sample IDs, Accession Numbers, Code snippets.

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Manrope:wght@500;600;700;800&display=swap');

primary.name: Indigo Precision
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, key links.

accent.name: Violet Insight
accent.usage: AI features, smart suggestions, premium actions.

rules: Use h-full on all children to ensure alignment.

cards.style: Flat, 1px border, no shadow by default.
cards.classes: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:border-indigo-200 transition-colors

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white shadow-sm rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium

inputs.style: bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 focus:bg-white focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-100 transition-all rounded-md

tables.header: bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 uppercase text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider

micro_interactions.hover: All interactive elements must have a hover state (color shift or slight lift).
micro_interactions.active: Buttons must scale down slightly (active:scale-95) on click.

shadows.usage: Minimal. Use shadows only for dropdowns, modals, and floating elements.

empty_state_samples.usage: Empty state for Sample Collection queue

technician_work.usage: Dashboard widget background or promo area

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is Slate-600 or darker on white backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All inputs must have visible focus rings (indigo-100).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds (use solid Slate-50 or White).
Always use 'Manrope' for headings to give character.
Maintain 'Clinical Precision' - align things perfectly, use borders to separate data.
